```{r}
#| label:Umap clustering CD8 
#| message: false
#| warnings: false
#| include: true
#| echo: false



# Ensure `CD8_T_Cells` is a dataframe
CD8_T_Cells <- as.data.frame(CD8_T_Cells)

# Check if `cluster_cols_CD8` contains valid column names
print(cluster_cols_CD8)

# Select the required columns and run UMAP
selected_data <- dplyr::select(CD8_T_Cells, all_of(cluster_cols_CD8))

umap_data_CD8 <- uwot::umap(
  selected_data,
  n_neighbors = 20,
  n_threads = parallel::detectCores() - 1,
  n_sgd_threads = parallel::detectCores() - 1,
  verbose = TRUE,
  seed = 520
)


#adding the umap columns to main df
colnames(umap_data_CD8) <- c("UMAP_X_CD8", "UMAP_Y_CD8") #rename the column names accordingly


#gluing on the UMAP columns to the expression data:
CD8_T_Cells[, "UMAP_X_CD8"] <- umap_data_CD8[,1]
CD8_T_Cells[, "UMAP_Y_CD8"] <- umap_data_CD8[,2]

colnames(CD8_T_Cells) #just to check

#visualising just xy coordinates in UMAP
umap_data_CD8 %>% 
  ggplot(aes(UMAP_X_CD8, UMAP_Y_CD8))+
  geom_hex(bins = 256)+
  coord_equal()

```

```{r}
#| label:Umap clustering CD8 with marker expression
#| message: false
#| warnings: false
#| include: true
#| echo: false


# Ensure dataframe
CD8_T_Cells <- as.data.frame(CD8_T_Cells)

# Convert to long format for marker-based UMAP coloring
CD8_umap_long <- CD8_T_Cells %>%
  dplyr::select(UMAP_X_CD8, UMAP_Y_CD8, all_of(cluster_cols_CD8)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(cluster_cols_CD8),
    names_to = "Marker",
    values_to = "Expression"
  )

# Faceted UMAP showing expression of each marker
umap_feature_plot_CD8 <- ggplot(
  CD8_umap_long,
  aes(x = UMAP_X_CD8, y = UMAP_Y_CD8, color = Expression)
) +
  geom_point(size = 0.3) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ Marker, ncol = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CD8 T cell UMAP colored by marker expression",
    color = "Expression"
  ) 

# Display plot
print(umap_feature_plot_CD8)

# Save faceted plot
ggsave("umap_feature_plot_CD8.pdf", plot = umap_feature_plot_CD8, width = 6, height = 4)

```

```{r}
#| label: using FastPG::fastCluster for parallel processing for CD8

selected_data_CD8 <- dplyr::select(CD8_T_Cells, all_of(cluster_cols_CD8))  
d.set_CD8<- as.matrix(selected_data_CD8)

#if K needs to be readjusted, run the following line between runs:
#exprn$fastCluster <- NULL #deletes existing column before attaching an updated one

#detect number of available threads:
num_threads = parallel::detectCores()-1
num_threads

#running the clustering
set.seed(520)

Clusters_out_CD8 <- FastPG::fastCluster(data = d.set_CD8,
                               num_threads,
                               k = 500)

# from Clusters_out, which is a kind of list, take the element called "communities" and add it to our exprn dataframe.
CD8_T_Cells$fastCluster_CD8 <- Clusters_out_CD8$communities

#how many clusters are there for a given k = n? -> this needs to be <32 to go with the colour pallette in the next code chunk
number_of_clusters <- max(CD8_T_Cells$fastCluster_CD8)
number_of_clusters

#write.csv(CD8_T_Cells, file = "CD8_T_Cells_FastPG_final.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: uplod back the final box data results incase R crushed 
#| message: false
#| warnings: false
#| include: true
#| eval: false

# Step 1: Your initial population creation and calculation of percentages remains the same


# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)

# Step 1: Assign Population_CD8 categories
CD8_T_Cells_box <- CD8_T_Cells %>%
  mutate(Population_CD8 = case_when(
    fastCluster_CD8 == 4 ~ "4",
    fastCluster_CD8 == 2 ~ "2",
    fastCluster_CD8 == 3 ~ "3", 
    fastCluster_CD8 == 1 ~ "1", 
    fastCluster_CD8 == 0 ~ "0", 
    TRUE ~ as.character(fastCluster_CD8)  # Default to cluster number if unmatched
  ))

CD8_T_Cells_box <- CD8_T_Cells_box %>%
  mutate(Treatment_CellType = interaction(Treatment, Cell_type, sep = "_", lex.order = TRUE))

# Step 2: Calculate population percentages from CD8_T_Cells_box
population_percentages_CD8 <- CD8_T_Cells_box %>%
  group_by(Treatment_CellType, Population_CD8, file) %>%
  summarize(Population_Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Treatment_CellType, file) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Cells = sum(Population_Count),
    Percent_Population = (Population_Count / Total_Cells) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(population_percentages_CD8, file = "population_percentages_CD8.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # https://www.rapidtables.com/web/color/RGB_Color.html

#  Set Treatment Colors
treatment_celltype_colors <- c(
  "untreated_ID8_R273H" = "#999999",
  "untreated_ID8_wt"    = "#999999",
  "untreated_PBMC"      = "#999999",
  
  "Ave_ID8_R273H"       = "#8BA6FF",
  "Ave_ID8_wt"          = "#8BA6FF",
  "Ave_PBMC"            = "#8BA6FF",
  
  "AR37_ID8_R273H"      = "#994c00",
  "AR37_ID8_wt"         = "#994c00",
  "AR37_PBMC"           = "#994c00",
  
  "Combo_ID8_R273H"     = "#009999",
  "Combo_ID8_wt"        = "#009999",
  "Combo_PBMC"          = "#009999"
)

treatment_order <- c(
  "untreated_PBMC", "Ave_PBMC", "AR37_PBMC", "Combo_PBMC",
  "untreated_ID8_wt", "Ave_ID8_wt", "AR37_ID8_wt", "Combo_ID8_wt",
  "untreated_ID8_R273H", "Ave_ID8_R273H", "AR37_ID8_R273H", "Combo_ID8_R273H"
)


# 1. Define populations
populations <- unique(population_percentages_CD8$Population_CD8)

# 2. Run ANOVA + Tukey HSD for each population, save results
tukey_results_list <- list()

for (pop in populations) {
  pop_data <- population_percentages_CD8 %>% filter(Population_CD8 == pop)
  
  if (n_distinct(pop_data$Treatment_CellType) > 1) {
    aov_model <- aov(Percent_Population ~ Treatment_CellType, data = pop_data)
    tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(aov_model)
    
    tukey_table <- as.data.frame(tukey_result$Treatment_CellType)
    tukey_table$Comparison <- rownames(tukey_table)
    tukey_table$Population <- pop
    
    tukey_results_list[[pop]] <- tukey_table
  }
}

# 3. Combine all Tukey results into one data frame and save to CSV
tukey_results_all <- bind_rows(tukey_results_list)
write.csv(tukey_results_all, "TukeyHSD_CD8_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 4. Plot boxplots (no significance annotations)
all_plots <- list()

for (pop in populations) {
  pop_data <- population_percentages_CD8 %>%
    filter(Population_CD8 == pop) %>%
    mutate(Treatment_CellType = factor(Treatment_CellType, levels = treatment_order))
  
  if (length(unique(pop_data$Treatment_CellType)) > 1) {
    p <- ggplot(pop_data, aes(x = Treatment_CellType, y = Percent_Population, fill = Treatment_CellType)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
      labs(title = paste0(pop, " of CD8"), y = "% Population", x = "Treatment & Cell Type") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_celltype_colors)
    
    all_plots[[pop]] <- p
  }
}


# 5. Save combined plot to PDF
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 2)
ggsave("boxplots_TreatmentCellType_Population_CD8_final_color.pdf", combined_plot, width = 14, height = 10)


# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # 
#from fileterd compariosn 
#  Define comparisons of interest
comparisons_of_interest <- c(
  "untreated_ID8_R273H-AR37_ID8_R273H",
  "untreated_ID8_wt-AR37_ID8_wt",
  "untreated_PBMC-AR37_PBMC",
  "untreated_ID8_R273H-Ave_ID8_R273H",
  "untreated_ID8_wt-Ave_ID8_wt",
  "untreated_PBMC-Ave_PBMC",
  "untreated_ID8_R273H-Combo_ID8_R273H",
  "untreated_ID8_wt-Combo_ID8_wt",
  "untreated_PBMC-Combo_PBMC"
)
# Subset from the combined Tukey table
tukey_results_filtered <- tukey_results_all %>%
  filter(Comparison %in% comparisons_of_interest)

write.csv(tukey_results_filtered, "TukeyHSD_CD8_filtered_results_final.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # CD8 done
```

```{r}
  pop_data <- population_percentages_CD4 %>% filter(Population_CD4 == pop)
  
  if (length(unique(pop_data$Treatment_CellType)) > 1) {
    p <- ggplot(pop_data, aes(x = Treatment_CellType, y = Percent_Population, fill = Treatment_CellType)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
      labs(title = paste0(pop, " of CD4"), y = "% Population", x = "Treatment & Cell Type") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_celltype_colors)
    
    all_plots[[pop]] <- p
  }
}

# 5. Save combined plot to PDF
combined_plot_CD4 <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 2)
ggsave("boxplots_TreatmentCellType_Population_CD4_final.pdf", combined_plot_CD4, width = 14, height = 10)


# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # #

comparisons_of_interest <- c(

  "untreated_PBMC-AR37_PBMC",
  "untreated_ID8_R273H-Ave_ID8_R273H",
  "untreated_ID8_wt-Ave_ID8_wt",
  "untreated_PBMC-Ave_PBMC",
  "untreated_ID8_R273H-Combo_ID8_R273H",
  "untreated_ID8_wt-Combo_ID8_wt",
```

```{r}
#| label: using FastPG::fastCluster for parallel processing for NK
#| message: false
#| warnings: false
#| include: true
#| echo: false


###########
selected_data_NK <- dplyr::select(NK_Cells, all_of(cluster_cols_NK))  
d.set_NK<- as.matrix(selected_data_NK)

#if K needs to be readjusted, run the following line between runs:
#exprn$fastCluster <- NULL #deletes existing column before attaching an updated one

#detect number of available threads:
num_threads = parallel::detectCores()-1
num_threads

#running the clustering
set.seed(520)

Clusters_out_NK <- FastPG::fastCluster(data = d.set_NK,
                               num_threads,
                               k = 500)

# from Clusters_out, which is a kind of list, take the element called "communities" and add it to our exprn dataframe.
NK_Cells$fastCluster_NK <- Clusters_out_NK$communities

#how many clusters are there for a given k = n? -> this needs to be <32 to go with the colour pallette in the next code chunk
number_of_clusters <- max(NK_Cells$fastCluster_NK)
number_of_clusters

#NK
write.csv(NK_Cells, file = "NK_Cells_FastPG_Final.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: uplod back the final box data results incase R crushed 
#| message: false
#| warnings: false
#| include: true
#| eval: false

# Step 1: Your initial population creation and calculation of percentages remains the same


# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)

# Step 1: Assign Population_NK categories
NK_Cells_box <- NK_Cells %>%
  mutate(Population_NK = case_when(
    fastCluster_NK == 4 ~ "4",
    fastCluster_NK == 2 ~ "2",
    fastCluster_NK == 3 ~ "3", 
    fastCluster_NK == 5 ~ "5",
    fastCluster_NK == 1 ~ "1", 
    fastCluster_NK == 0 ~ "0", 
    TRUE ~ as.character(fastCluster_NK)  # Default to cluster number if unmatched
  ))

NK_Cells_box <- NK_Cells_box %>%
  mutate(Treatment_CellType = interaction(Treatment, Cell_type, sep = "_", lex.order = TRUE))

# Step 2: Calculate population percentages from NK_Cells_box
population_percentages_NK <- NK_Cells_box %>%
  group_by(Treatment_CellType, Population_NK, file) %>%
  summarize(Population_Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Treatment_CellType, file) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Cells = sum(Population_Count),
    Percent_Population = (Population_Count / Total_Cells) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(population_percentages_NK, file = "population_percentages_NK_final.csv", row.names = FALSE)


# # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # # 

#  Set Treatment Colors
treatment_celltype_colors <- c(
  "untreated_ID8_R273H" = "#999999",
  "untreated_ID8_wt"    = "#bfbfbf",
  "untreated_PBMC"      = "#e0e0e0",
  
  "Ave_ID8_R273H"       = "#fdae61",
  "Ave_ID8_wt"          = "#fdc996",
  "Ave_PBMC"            = "#fee6c9",
  
  "AR37_ID8_R273H"      = "#abd9e9",
  "AR37_ID8_wt"         = "#cde5f0",
  "AR37_PBMC"           = "#e8f2f8",
  
  "Combo_ID8_R273H"     = "#2c7bb6",
  "Combo_ID8_wt"        = "#589cc6",
  "Combo_PBMC"          = "#a3cce2"
)

treatment_order <- c(
  "untreated_PBMC", "Ave_PBMC", "AR37_PBMC", "Combo_PBMC",
  "untreated_ID8_wt", "Ave_ID8_wt", "AR37_ID8_wt", "Combo_ID8_wt",
  "untreated_ID8_R273H", "Ave_ID8_R273H", "AR37_ID8_R273H", "Combo_ID8_R273H"
)

# 1. Define populations
populations <- unique(population_percentages_NK$Population_NK)

tukey_results_list <- list()

for (pop in populations) {
  pop_data <- population_percentages_NK %>% filter(Population_NK == pop)
  
  if (n_distinct(pop_data$Treatment_CellType) > 1) {
    aov_model <- aov(Percent_Population ~ Treatment_CellType, data = pop_data)
    tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(aov_model)
    
    tukey_table <- as.data.frame(tukey_result$Treatment_CellType)
    tukey_table$Comparison <- rownames(tukey_table)
    tukey_table$Population <- pop
    
    tukey_results_list[[pop]] <- tukey_table
  }
}

# 3. Combine all Tukey results into one data frame and save to CSV
tukey_results_NK <- bind_rows(tukey_results_list)
write.csv(tukey_results_NK, "TukeyHSD_NK_results_final.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 4. Plot boxplots (no significance annotations)
all_plots <- list()

for (pop in populations) {
  pop_data <- population_percentages_NK %>% filter(Population_NK == pop)
  
  if (length(unique(pop_data$Treatment_CellType)) > 1) {
    q <- ggplot(pop_data, aes(x = Treatment_CellType, y = Percent_Population, fill = Treatment_CellType)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
      labs(title = paste0(pop, " of NK"), y = "% Population", x = "Treatment & Cell Type") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_celltype_colors)
    
    all_plots[[pop]] <- q
  }
}

# 5. Save combined plot to PDF
combined_plot_NK <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 2)
ggsave("boxplots_TreatmentCellType_Population_NK_final.pdf", combined_plot_NK, width = 14, height = 10)
```
